name: Managed identity
short_description: A managed identity is an identity for an application or Azure resource whose credentials Azure creates and rotates automatically, so no secret has to be stored in code or configuration files.

evidence.quote: That could be a user, a group, an application identity, or a managed identity that Azure creates and rotates
A managed identity is an identity that Azure creates
It's called a managed identity, and it works on virtual machines.
Managed identities can reduce stored application credentials
Microsoft Entry ID can issue tokens for the managed identity
It adds managed identity, authenticated device connections, device facing controls
Os agentes do Copilot Studio funcionam principalmente por delegação de usuário, não por identidades gerenciadas.
And how important are the managed identities in modern logic app architectures?
